prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — a couple quick questions so I give the best recommendation:
- What vehicle do you have (make/model/year) and what kind of tires are you looking for (all‑season, performance/summer, winter, all‑terrain)?
- Do you want the lowest price, best long‑term value/performance, or the most convenient/fastest service?

General guidance for Pleasanton, CA

Options to consider
- Costco Tire Center — great prices and strong installation/package value (if you have a membership). They include lifetime balancing and rotation in many locations and handle warranty work reliably.
- Discount Tire / America’s Tire — well rated for customer service and installation quality; they do mounting, balancing and quick scheduling.
- National service centers (Firestone Complete Auto Care, Pep Boys) — convenient, frequent promotions, and will do alignment/TPMS as needed.
- Tire Rack / online sellers (Tire Rack, SimpleTire, TireBuyer) — you can buy online and ship to a recommended installer in Pleasanton; this often gets you better tire selection or pricing while still using a local shop for installation.
- Local independent shops — often the best personalized installation and follow‑up (alignment, careful mounting, attention to TPMS). Look for shops with ASE‑certified techs and strong Google/Yelp ratings.

How to pick the best installer
- Check reviews on Google and Yelp and look for recent comments about mounting/balancing quality and warranty handling.
- Ask if they perform road‑force or dynamic balancing (helpful for high‑performance or uneven tires).
- Confirm alignment capability and whether an alignment is included/discounted with new tires.
- Make sure TPMS sensors, valve stems, mounting/balancing fees, and tire disposal fees are disclosed up front.
- Ask about road‑hazard warranties and who handles warranty claims.

If you want, I can:
- Look up and list top-rated tire shops and chains near your zip code with addresses and phone numbers.
- Get price comparisons for a specific tire size/model you need.

Tell me your vehicle, tire preference and whether you want me to search for nearby shops (and give your zip code or allow me to use Pleasanton), and I’ll pull a short list with ratings and pros/cons.
